title: Gaussian upper-tail logarithmic asymptotic
statement: Let $Q(t)$ be the upper-tail probability above $t$ for a standard normal random variable. As $t\to+\infty$, $\sqrt{2\log(1/Q(t))}/t$ tends to $1$.
